# Amorphous_Amorphous_Transition

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A phase transition between two disordered (glassy) states of matter, driven by pressure or other external parameters, without crystallization. Offers a tunable physical mechanism for creating bistable or multistable states in neuromorphic substrates, mimicking synaptic plasticity.
